Definition: from G5259 and εἴκω (to yield, be "weak"); to surrender:--submit self.
BiblicalUsage: The word hypeíkō carries the sense of to yield, to submit oneself. In Hebrews 13:17, the text says "and submit yourselves."
TheologicalSignificance: This one, hypeíkō, I take at face value: to yield, to submit oneself.
